profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced Computer Graphics Generalist with a demonstrated history of working in the animation and VR industry. Skilled in game engines (Unity, Unreal), real time graphics (three.js, GLSL, WebGL, glTF), and animation packages (Maya, Houdini). Dynamic problem solver with a strong engineering and art background from the University of Pennsylvania, BSE in Digital Media Design.

positions.title: CG Generalist
positions.description:
Crow: The Legend | Interactive VR Animation | 2019 Daytime Emmy winner for “Outstanding Interactive”
Engineer and lighting artist on Crow: The Legend. 
Integrated an IK solution for interactivity, managed the animation import pipeline, set up various sequences, and led the 360 video renders of the experience.

Asteroids! | Interactive VR Animation | 2018 Daytime Emmy winner for “Outstanding Interactive”
Ported Asteroids! to Android and Windows Mixed Reality platforms using Unity Engine.
Implemented in-experience scene selection interface with real time video tiles.

positions.title: CG Generalist Intern, Oculus Story Studio
positions.description:
Implemented various pipeline tools for the shading, lighting, and animation departments.
Integrated the Granite SDK texture streaming library into a custom UE4 engine.
Tested video capture tools and documented best practices.
Road tested the real time global illumination tool Enlighten.

positions.title: Pixar Undergraduate Program
positions.description: Completed projects in each department of the Pixar technical director pipeline. Played a Global Technology role in a nine person group project, creating vegetation networks and providing pipeline support. Created a procedural favella in Houdini as the final two week independent project.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description: Created games, interactive concept videos, puzzles, and exercises to teach programming concepts to grade schoolers.

honors.title: CG Generalist on "Crow: The Legend" - 2019 Daytime Emmy winner for “Outstanding Interactive”
Engineer on "Asteroids!" - 2018 Daytime Emmy winner for “Outstanding Interactive”

projects.title: WebGL Unified Particle System
projects.description: Unified particle and rigid body simulation in WebGL, using the discrete element method to calculate interparticle forces and representing rigid bodies as sets of particles to accelerate simulation.

projects.title: BioCrowds Foraging
projects.description: Crowd simulation of an ant colony foraging for food, combining the BioCrowds space colonization algorithm for local collision avoidance and a robot swarm algorithm for global navigation.
